entries.0b53df021fc8f638: It has the 'Regional Revitalization Platform Concept', which supports regional revitalization with public-private collaboration as its engine, and consists of 2 platforms: the 'Communication Platform', which supports information dissemination and exchange in local communities, and the 'Solution Platform', which promotes DX in local communities. The administrative information magazine 'Wagamachi Jiten' has achieved joint publication with more than 1,100 local governments, and the digital signage 'Wagamachi NAVI' is installed at more than 300 locations through public-private collaboration. At the same time, it is working to improve employees' capabilities and productivity through investment in human capital, including introducing AI training, and to reduce cost of sales and expenses; it is also considering and implementing alliances and M&A with companies whose synergies with the group's business are expected, to expand its business areas, aiming to increase consolidated revenue.

entries.31a1b5a9a5984ddd: Consolidated subsidiary SCINEX Network Co., Ltd. distributes information magazines such as “Waga Machi Jiten” and “Telepal 50” and handles flyer posting outsourced by external clients, and Ernet Co., Ltd. carries out the DM solution business (DM mailing agency). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,067 million, the largest of the five reportable segments.
entries.32fc01d95152c1f8: Its strength lies in having built up, over about 20 years, the public-private administrative information magazine business model it started in 2006 (Heisei 18), and in having a track record of joint publication with more than 1,100 of the approximately 1,700 municipalities nationwide. In addition to a structure of collecting advertising from local businesses through about 40 sales bases nationwide, its own group handles distribution of the magazines and DM mailings, so it can provide the service consistently from publication through distribution. Its foundation is also rooted in a community-based base built over more than 70 years since its founding, during which it has published telephone directories.
entries.4ac3150ef239911e: Based on the principle of Public-Private Partnership, it publishes administrative information magazines, including “Waga Machi Jiten,” child-rearing guides and health information magazines, as joint public-private projects with local governments. It plans and publishes the 50-sound telephone directory “Telepal 50” as an advertising medium, and also installs digital signage “Waga Machi NAVI,” operates the city promotion website “Waga Machi Portal,” and sells “Waga Machi Mapping,” a Google Business Profile service. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,694 million.
